sourceText: User approved opening a small story for Multi-Model Ablation M2 Launch Readiness after the B-806b M1 launch gate remained blocked by five Phase 1 launch blockers.
normalizedOutcome: B-fe25 produces provider-free M2 launch-readiness artifacts and a local checker; the status table shows M0/M1 done, M2 launch readiness prepared, M2 execution not started, and ③ calibration plus ⑥ A2prime still ordered execution steps.
acceptanceClaim: The acceptance claim is satisfied when m2-launch-readiness-check.mjs passes, m2-status.md displays the milestone/blocker table, no provider calls or outcome records exist, and experiments/recovery-runner/tasks remains unmodified.
